title: Gmail for founders on Mac: answer investors and customers faster by voice
metaTitle: Gmail for founders on Mac: reply faster by voice
description: Gmail for founders on Mac: the settings that save time, plus how Lazur drafts replies from the email on screen so investor and customer threads move faster.
intro: Gmail for founders is mostly replies: investors, customers, hires. Turn on keyboard shortcuts and templates, then let Lazur draft the reply from the email on your screen while you say what it should say.
tldr: Turn on keyboard shortcuts: Settings > See all settings > Keyboard shortcuts.
Use Schedule send so replies land at a sensible hour.
Hold ⌥ ⌘ and say the reply. Lazur writes it in the compose box.

demo.spoken: reply, thanks for the intro, happy to talk next week, suggest Tuesday or Wednesday
demo.result: Wrote the reply for you to check.
demo.output:
Thanks for the intro, Sam.

Happy to talk next week. Does Tuesday or Wednesday work for you?

Best,
Veer

research this company before the call

items: Keyboard shortcuts on: e archives, r replies.

faq.question: Does Lazur read my whole inbox?
faq.answer: No. It sees the screen only while you hold the shortcut.
